raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
Part 11 of 21 of the LoRA runtime stack (branch `lora-stack-10-moe-routing`, base `lora-stack-09-moe-plans`). The stack is cut from the development branch of #42284.

## What this part adds

Add the MoE route factory: per-plan route bundles over the shared route
builder (aligned and raw views, shared-token routes, route PDL wiring keyed by
architecture).

Tests: PDL wiring, shared-token routes, launch-config route preflight.

## Verification

- H200 run r41 (2026-10-19): the tree of upstream main `33dd8f6a2eee` plus parts 01–11 imports every module this part changes and passes this part's tests together with every earlier part's unit tests: **570 passed, 20 warnings, 189 subtests passed in 31.23s**.
- `pre-commit` passed on the changed files of every part; `pre-commit run --all-files` passed on the complete stack tree.

The complete 21-part tree equals the development branch of #42284 at `4e92ccf664` (the `5f1092b446` tree rebased onto upstream main `33dd8f6a2eee`; the three engine commits are unchanged apart from the dense commit's conflict resolutions in the runner imports, the decode-graph warmup hook and the MLA-correction imports) minus the benchmark tools and the Triton MoE tuning tables, which follow in separate PRs.

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,132 @@
+"""Build the route views required by a MoE LoRA plan."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.kernels.ops.lora.common.route_view import RouteView, RouteViewKind
+from sglang.kernels.ops.lora.common.routing import build_route
+from sglang.srt.lora.moe.plan import (
+    MoePlan,
+    RouteBuilderFamily,
+    RouteRequirement,
+)
+from sglang.srt.lora.workspace import LoraWorkspace
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class MoeLoraRoutes:
+    raw_per_expert: RouteView | None = None
+    raw_shared_outer: RouteView | None = None
+    aligned_per_expert: RouteView | None = None
+    aligned_shared_outer: RouteView | None = None
+    shared_token: RouteView | None = None
+
+    def raw(self, is_shared_outer: bool) -> RouteView:
+        if is_shared_outer:
+            return self._require(self.raw_shared_outer, "raw_shared_outer")
+        return self._require(self.raw_per_expert, "raw_per_expert")
+
+    def aligned(self, is_shared_outer: bool) -> RouteView:
+        if is_shared_outer:
+            return self._require(self.aligned_shared_outer, "aligned_shared_outer")
+        return self._require(self.aligned_per_expert, "aligned_per_expert")
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _require(route: RouteView | None, field: str) -> RouteView:
+        if route is None:
+            raise ValueError(f"the execution plan did not request {field}")
+        return route
+
+
+def build_moe_routes(
+    plan: MoePlan,
+    *,
+    topk_ids: torch.Tensor,
+    token_lora_mapping: torch.Tensor,
+    num_local_experts: int,
+    max_loras: int,
+    block_size: int,
+    workspace: LoraWorkspace,
+) -> MoeLoraRoutes:
+    requirements = plan.route_requirements()
+    values: dict[str, RouteView] = {}
+    if RouteRequirement.RAW_PER_EXPERT in requirements:
+        values["raw_per_expert"] = build_route(
+            token_lora_mapping,
+            group_ids=topk_ids,
+            groups_per_slot=num_local_experts,
+            max_loras=max_loras,
+            block_size=block_size,
+            view=RouteViewKind.RAW,
+        )
+    if RouteRequirement.RAW_SHARED_OUTER in requirements:
+        values["raw_shared_outer"] = build_route(
+            token_lora_mapping,
+            group_ids=topk_ids,
+            groups_per_slot=1,
+            max_loras=max_loras,
+            block_size=block_size,
+            view=RouteViewKind.RAW,
+        )
+
+    def _build_per_expert() -> RouteView:
+        return build_route(
+            token_lora_mapping,
+            group_ids=topk_ids,
+            groups_per_slot=num_local_experts,
+            max_loras=max_loras,
+            block_size=block_size,
+            view=RouteViewKind.ALIGNED,
+            workspace=workspace,
+            tensor_prefix="route:aligned_per_expert",
+        )
+
+    def _build_shared() -> None:
+        values["aligned_shared_outer"] = build_route(
+            token_lora_mapping,
+            group_ids=topk_ids,
+            groups_per_slot=1,
+            max_loras=max_loras,
+            block_size=block_size,
+            view=RouteViewKind.ALIGNED,
+            workspace=workspace,
+            tensor_prefix="route:aligned_shared_outer",
+        )
+
+    if (
+        plan.route_builder is RouteBuilderFamily.PARALLEL_SHARED_OUTER
+        and RouteRequirement.ALIGNED_PER_EXPERT in requirements
+        and RouteRequirement.ALIGNED_SHARED_OUTER in requirements
+    ):
+        values["aligned_per_expert"] = workspace.run_parallel(
+            name="route:parallel",
+            device=topk_ids.device,
+            compute=_build_per_expert,
+            side=_build_shared,
+        )
+    else:
+        if RouteRequirement.ALIGNED_PER_EXPERT in requirements:
+            values["aligned_per_expert"] = _build_per_expert()
+        if RouteRequirement.ALIGNED_SHARED_OUTER in requirements:
+            _build_shared()
+
+    if RouteRequirement.SHARED_TOKEN_PLAN in requirements:
+
+        def build_token_route():
+            # Shared experts use one row per token, grouped by adapter slot.
+            return build_route(
+                token_lora_mapping,
+                max_loras=max_loras,
+                block_size=block_size,
+                view=RouteViewKind.ALIGNED,
+                workspace=workspace,
+                tensor_prefix=f"route:shared_token:sorted:{block_size}",
+            )
+
+        values["shared_token"] = workspace.route(
+            token_lora_mapping, ("sorted", block_size, max_loras), build_token_route
+        )
+    return MoeLoraRoutes(**values)

@@ -246,5 +246,108 @@ def compute():
     assert order == ["side", "compute"]
 
 
+def test_route_cache_keys_match_mapping_and_options():
+    workspace = Workspace()
+    slots = torch.arange(32, dtype=torch.int32) % 4
+    key, build = ("sorted", 16, 4), Mock(side_effect=object)
+    first = workspace.route(slots, key, build)
+    assert workspace.route(slots[:], key, build) is first
+    build.assert_called_once_with()
+    for mapping, options in (
+        (slots.clone(), key),
+        (slots[:16], key),
+        (slots[1:17], key),
+        (slots[::2], key),
+        (slots.view(torch.float32), key),
+        (slots, ("sorted", 32, 4)),
+        (slots, ("sorted", 16, 8)),
+    ):
+        build.reset_mock()
+        route = workspace.route(mapping, options, build)
+        assert workspace.route(mapping, options, build) is route
+        build.assert_called_once_with()
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "requested,parallel,joins",
+    [
+        (("RAW_PER_EXPERT", "RAW_SHARED_OUTER", "SHARED_TOKEN_PLAN"), False, False),
+        (("ALIGNED_PER_EXPERT", "ALIGNED_SHARED_OUTER"), False, False),
+        (("ALIGNED_PER_EXPERT", "ALIGNED_SHARED_OUTER"), True, True),
+        (("ALIGNED_PER_EXPERT",), True, False),
+        (("ALIGNED_SHARED_OUTER",), True, False),
+    ],
+)
+def test_moe_route_bundle_builds_only_requested_products(
+    monkeypatch, requested, parallel, joins
+):
+    from sglang.srt.lora.moe import routing as moe_routing
+    from sglang.srt.lora.moe.plan import RouteBuilderFamily, RouteRequirement
+
+    slots = torch.tensor([0, 1, -1], dtype=torch.int32)
+    topk = torch.tensor([[0, 2], [1, 0], [-1, 2]], dtype=torch.int32)
+    workspace = Workspace()
+    join = Mock(wraps=workspace.run_parallel)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(workspace, "run_parallel", join)
+
+    built = {}
+
+    def build(mapping, **kwargs):
+        route = object()
+        built[route] = mapping, kwargs
+        return route
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(moe_routing, "build_route", build)
+    plan = SimpleNamespace(
+        route_requirements=lambda: {RouteRequirement[name] for name in requested},
+        route_builder=(
+            RouteBuilderFamily.PARALLEL_SHARED_OUTER
+            if parallel
+            else RouteBuilderFamily.STANDARD
+        ),
+    )
+
+    def routes():
+        return moe_routing.build_moe_routes(
+            plan,
+            topk_ids=topk,
+            token_lora_mapping=slots,
+            num_local_experts=3,
+            max_loras=2,
+            block_size=16,
+            workspace=workspace,
+        )
+
+    first = routes()
+    assert len(built) == len(requested)
+    assert join.call_count == int(joins)
+    if joins:
+        assert list(built) == [first.aligned_shared_outer, first.aligned_per_expert]
+    for requirement in RouteRequirement:
+        name = requirement.name
+        field = name.lower().removesuffix("_plan")
+        route = getattr(first, field)
+        assert (route is not None) == (name in requested)
+        if route is not None:
+            mapping, args = built[route]
+            assert mapping is slots
+            assert args["view"].value == (
+                "raw" if name.startswith("RAW_") else "aligned"
+            )
+            assert args.get("group_ids") is (
+                None if name == "SHARED_TOKEN_PLAN" else topk
+            )
+            assert args.get("groups_per_slot", 1) == (
+                3 if name.endswith("PER_EXPERT") else 1
+            )
+            assert (args["max_loras"], args["block_size"]) == (2, 16)
+            if name.startswith("ALIGNED_"):
+                assert args["tensor_prefix"] == f"route:{field}"
+    if first.shared_token is not None:
+        topk.add_(1)
+        assert routes().shared_token is first.shared_token
+        assert len(built) == 2 * len(requested) - 1
+
+
 if __name__ == "__main__":
     raise SystemExit(pytest.main([__file__, "-v"]))
